title: CobbleStars
description: We're a Cobblemon Network where you can start your new Pokémon adventure, train your Pokémon, challenge gyms, and become the best Trainer. Explore, battle, trade, and show off your skills in a world full of fun!
body:
Are you looking for a server to play Pokémon in Minecraft with other people? Introducing CobbleStars, a Minecraft server featuring the Cobblemon mod, where you can play with your favorite Pokémon, battle other players, and join our Spanish-speaking community. What does our server offer?

- Pokémon skins
- Quests
- Wonder Trade
- Ranked mode
- Events
- Lore
- GTS
- Hunts
- MTS
- Breeding
- Economy
- Dynamax
- Terastallization
- Z-Moves
- Mega Evolutions
- Resource World
- Mounts
